description:

What this is
A loud, bold garden flag made to spotlight the last-place manager with good-natured humiliation. The art uses bright blue with orange accents so the message reads from across the room — perfect for draft parties, watch parties, the toilet-bowl ceremony, office desks, or end-of-season celebrations.

Who made it
This listing and layout were created with AI-assisted copy/layout work and are fulfilled by a trusted print-on-demand production partner. Your flag is printed to order by that production partner using weather-resistant polyester inks and construction.

Notes
• Garden-flag stand is not included; this flag fits standard 12 x 18 garden-flag poles via the top pole sleeve.
• Printed to order for each purchase; please allow production time before shipping (production times and shipping options are provided at checkout).

Tone & use
Funny, competitive, and boldly humiliating in the spirit of league camaraderie. Ideal gift for fantasy football loser pranks, league gag gifts, or end-of-season bragging rights for everyone else.
rationale: Scoreboard style for an athletic, in-your-face sports vibe; bold, block typography reads like a game-day display. Palette set to blue with orange accents to match the requested bright blue and orange treatment and to stand out in party or yard settings. Eyebrow (LAST PLACE CERTIFIED) and footer (ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE) are retained exactly to strengthen the mock-official, league-wide-proof angle.
